exceptions.scope: development-only transitive dependency of the ESLint toolchain
exceptions.rationale: The compatible ESLint 9 and eslint-config-next 16.2 lines still resolve minimatch 3, whose brace-expansion 1.x dependency has no patched release. Forcing brace-expansion 5 or minimatch 10 across incompatible ranges would be an unverified major override.
mitigations: Production installs and the standalone image omit the development-only lint graph.
ESLint and minimatch process repository-controlled configuration and file patterns only; no request data reaches this dependency.
Production audit remains a blocking zero-vulnerability gate.
Re-evaluate the compatible ESLint/Next toolchain and remove this exception by the review date.
